## Problem

What problem does this solve, and for which role(s)? (owner, staff,
accountant, reseller, affiliate, client, super_admin)

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature. Reference the relevant group in

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they were not chosen.

## Impact on existing architecture

- [ ] Requires a new environment variable
- [ ] Requires a new database table or migration
- [ ] Touches payment processing or payouts
- [ ] Touches file storage (Google Drive adapter)
- [ ] Touches tenant isolation / row level security
- [ ] None of the above

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or related issues.
